description.content: Gets a list of all `Invite` entities.

query.description: Limits the results to a specified number, defaults to 50
Offsets the results to a specified number, defaults to 0

A comma separated list of case-insensitive colour values.
i.e., `red`, `green`, `yellow`, and `orange`
A comma separated list of Location IDs
Sorts by the field name and direction provided where the pattern is `FIELD_NAME_DIRECTION`
Filters results to all those *before* the provided datetime
Filters results to all those *after* the provided datetime

A list of comma-separated related models to include
i.e., 'assigned_stall'
True to return approved and auto approved invites, False to return pending and rejected invites
Checks that an invite hasn't yet started, or has started and is still active after a specified time
Checks that an invite hasn't ended before a specified time

response.name: Successful response - returns an array of `Invite` entities.

description.content:
The Traction Guest API is currently under limited release to select customers as we gather and iterate on feedback.

# Getting Started
If you are interested in getting early access to the API, please send us an email to [support@tractionguest.com](mailto:support@tractionguest.com).

We will also add you to our Slack channel where you can ask questions and get further help.

# Terms and Conditions
Please visit: [https://signinsolutions.com/compliance-hub](https://signinsolutions.com/compliance-hub)

# Versioning
This API follows [semantic versioning](https://semver.org/), which follows the `Major`.`Minor`.`Patch` format.

* The `Major` number increments when potentially incompatible changes are made.
* The `Minor` number increments when backwards-compatible additions are made.
* The `Patch` number increments when backwards-compatible bug-fixes are made.
